title: CI: a patches promotion or log is stuck
thread:
**Issue #4272 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4272: CI: a patches promotion or log is stuck
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

<!-- stuck #4269 -->
The card-patch promotion https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/4269 (`patches ship`, R646) has been open over 2 hours and did not merge itself:

- [rust (test cards)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44566108853/job/135710240255)
- [rust](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44566108853/job/135714824660)

Until it merges, the patches it ships are not live as versions: `CATALOG_VERSION` stays where it was and the patch notes do not show them.

Fix it on a branch from main: a check that only fails here usually reads the shipped history (`crates/cards/patches/`) and must hold for the history this promotion ships, so check out its branch and run the failing tests there to see it fail first, then show them pass there with the fix. A conflict alone needs no fix. Close this issue with the fix's pull request (or, for a conflict alone, by hand); the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` then ships again from the newer main, and that promotion supersedes this one.

If they are red for a reason outside the repository (CI out of minutes, a spending limit, billing, an account, a runner that never started), no change here fixes it: open the plan with a `**Human required:**` line saying what a person must do, and build nothing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44593606891)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** Promotion #4269 (`patches ship` from main at `2de57a9a23`, which ships v0.6.7k, #4268's win-rate refresh, R3882000) is red in `rust (test cards)`. One test fails, and only on the history it ships: `cross::lesson_pools::r2201001_a_held_lesson_shows_no_legendary_or_mythic_card::r2201001_random_games_under_the_hold_never_show_one_and_the_same_games_unheld_do` panics at `crates/cards/tests/cross/lesson_pools.rs:149` with `game 4 under the hold showed [("stinkyscapeplus-123", 292)]`. `rust` is the job that collects the others' results, so it is red only because of this test. The new record changes the tier pools, so the random game takes a different path, and at step 292 it plays the fused card `t-13:stinkyscapeplus-137+stinkyscapeplus-135`. That card's The Perfect Pair Cry adds Quad (122) and Oct (123, Legendary) by name. The engine is right here: R2201001 does not hold a card that a card's text names, and R77 says a fused card runs every ingredient's scripts. The test is wrong: it matches only the bare id `stinkyscapeplus-137`. Done means the test treats a fused card as the ingredients it was made from; the whole `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards` passes both on main's history and on the history v0.6.7k ships; and the builder showed the test failing on the shipped history first and passing there with the fix. Close #4272 with the pull request.

I reproduced all of this in a scratch worktree. Before the fix, `patches ship` printed `patches ship: shipped v0.6.7k` and the test binary ran 1226 passed and 1 failed. With the fix it ran 1228 passed on the shipped history, both `lesson_pools` tests passed on main's history, and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check` and the doc tests were clean. The cause is inside the repository, so no person is needed.

**Files to touch.**

| Path | Kind | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/tests/cross/lesson_pools.rs` | change | Import `self_def_ids`. New helper `stands_for_any`. `named_by_a_card_in_play` and the two `names_one` checks use it. New test `r2201001_a_fused_card_names_the_held_cards_its_ingredients_name`. |

Touch nothing else:
- No change to `crates/engine` or to any card script. The engine's behaviour is correct.
- No ruling note, no `spec/pending/`, no patches fragment. `classify` counts any path with `/tests/` in it as Internal, so no fragment is needed.
- Nothing under `crates/cards/patches/`. The fix is tested against the shipped history in a scratch worktree, never in the delivered one.
- Nothing under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` or `bot/`.

What governs this:
- **R2201001**: `poolHold`, and its exception for a card the text names outright.
- **R77**: a fused card concatenates its ingredients' scripts.
- **R179**: a fused id is `t-<n>:<a>+<b>`, a fused ingredient goes in parentheses, and R469 adds a `*` for a Radiant ingredient.
- **R3565004**: The Perfect Pair names its five pairs.

`lesson_pools.rs` is already in R2201001's `proven_in`.

**Steps.**

1. Reproduce first. Run these from your own worktree, whose HEAD is main:
   ```
   git worktree add --detach /tmp/ship-4269 HEAD
   cd /tmp/ship-4269
   CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/ship-target cargo run --release -p jackioh-tools -- patches ship
   CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/ship-target cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards lesson_pools
   ```
   - `patches ship` should print `patches ship: shipped v0.6.7k`.
   - The test must FAIL with `game 4 under the hold showed [("stinkyscapeplus-123", 292)]`.
   - If main has moved, the version and the game may differ. Record what you see.
   - Then go back to your own worktree for steps 2 to 6.

2. In `crates/cards/tests/cross/lesson_pools.rs`, line 8, change the import to:
   ```rust
   use jackioh_engine::catalog::{HELD_RARITIES, deckable, made_by_a_rule, self_def_ids};
   ```

3. Right after `const NAMED_BY_A_CARD_IN_PLAY …;` (line 33), add a blank line and then:
   ```rust
   /// Whether `def_id` is one of `ids`, or a fused card (R179) with one of them among its ingredients:
   /// a fused card runs every ingredient's scripts (R77), so it names whatever they name.
   fn stands_for_any(state: Option<&GameState>, def_id: &str, ids: &[&str]) -> bool {
       self_def_ids(state, def_id)
           .iter()
           .any(|id| ids.contains(&id.as_str()))
   }
   ```
   `self_def_ids` returns `vec![def_id]` for an id that was not fused. For a fused id it returns every ingredient, nested fusions included and Radiant marks dropped. A digest id needs the state.

4. Replace the body of `named_by_a_card_in_play`. Keep its doc comment and signature. The new body:
   ```rust
       let text = serde_json::to_string(state).expect("the state serializes");
       NAMED_BY_A_CARD_IN_PLAY.iter().any(|(named, namer)| {
           *named == id
               && text
                   .split("\"defId\":\"")
                   .skip(1)
                   .filter_map(|piece| piece.split('"').next())
                   .any(|def_id| stands_for_any(Some(state), def_id, &[*namer]))
       })
   ```

5. In `sweep`, change the two `names_one` checks.
   - In the `ActionBody::Play` arm, replace `.is_some_and(|card| NAMES_A_HELD_CARD.contains(&card.def_id.as_str())),` with:
     ```rust
     .is_some_and(|card| stands_for_any(Some(&state), &card.def_id, NAMES_A_HELD_CARD)),
     ```
   - In the `GameEvent::CardPlayed` guard, replace `if NAMES_A_HELD_CARD.contains(&def_id.as_str()))` with:
     ```rust
     if stands_for_any(Some(&result.state), def_id, NAMES_A_HELD_CARD))
     ```
     This compiles because both borrows are shared and happen before `state = result.state;`.

6. Inside `mod r2201001_a_held_lesson_shows_no_legendary_or_mythic_card`, after the existing test, add:
   ```rust
       #[test]
       fn r2201001_a_fused_card_names_the_held_cards_its_ingredients_name() {
           // The Perfect Pair fused (R77, R179) still adds Quad and Oct by name: the sweep's game 4 at
           // v0.6.7k (#4272) played this very card.
           let fused = "t-13:stinkyscapeplus-137+stinkyscapeplus-135";
           assert!(stands_for_any(None, fused, NAMES_A_HELD_CARD));
           assert!(stands_for_any(
               None,
               "t-2:(t-1:stinkyscapeplus-135+stinkyscapeplus-137)+core-001",
               NAMES_A_HELD_CARD
           ));
           assert!(stands_for_any(None, "stinkyscapeplus-137", NAMES_A_HELD_CARD));
           assert!(!stands_for_any(None, "stinkyscapeplus-135", NAMES_A_HELD_CARD));
           assert!(!stands_for_any(
               None,
               "t-1:stinkyscapeplus-135+core-001",
               NAMES_A_HELD_CARD
           ));
           // A fused Crawler adds its Toxopid as the bare Crawler does.
           assert!(stands_for_any(
               None,
               "t-3:stinkyscapeplus-120*+core-001",
               &["stinkyscapeplus-120"]
           ));
       }
   ```
   Then run `cargo fmt`. The code above is already rustfmt's layout.

7. Show the fix passing on the shipped history, then clean up:
   ```
   cp crates/cards/tests/cross/lesson_pools.rs /tmp/ship-4269/crates/cards/tests/cross/lesson_pools.rs
   cd /tmp/ship-4269
   CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/ship-target cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards
   ```
   - The test binary must pass in full: 1228 passed when I ran it.
   - Then go back and run `git worktree remove --force /tmp/ship-4269 && git worktree prune`. Only your own worktree is delivered.

**Tests.**

All in `crates/cards/tests/cross/lesson_pools.rs`:
- `r2201001_random_games_under_the_hold_never_show_one_and_the_same_games_unheld_do` (existing): fails at step 1 on the shipped history and passes after step 7, and passes on main.
- `r2201001_a_fused_card_names_the_held_cards_its_ingredients_name` (new): a fused id that holds a namer counts as that namer, directly or nested; an id with no namer does not; a Radiant Crawler ingredient counts for `NAMED_BY_A_CARD_IN_PLAY`. Put back the bare-id comparison and it fails on main's history too.

Commands, from your own worktree:
```
cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards lesson_pools
cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards
cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
cargo jackioh spec check
```
On the shipped history, run the commands in steps 1 and 7.

**Done when.**
- [ ] Step 1 showed the test failing on the shipped history. Quote its panic line in the report.
- [ ] Step 7 showed the whole `--test cards` binary passing on the shipped history.
- [ ] Both `lesson_pools` tests pass in your own worktree, which holds main's history.
- [ ] rustfmt, clippy, the cargo tests, `spec check`, `catalog check` and `patches check` are green.
- [ ] `/tmp/ship-4269` is removed, and `git status` shows only `lesson_pools.rs` changed.
- [ ] The report names the cause (a fused The Perfect Pair) and says the pull request closes #4272.

**Risks.**
- **Games, replays, hidden information:** none is touched. The change is only in a test, and no engine, script or wire code changes.
- **A later failure:** the sweep's 15 games still depend on the tier pools. Another history could reach another namer through a path the test does not model, and fail again. That would be another stuck promotion to fix the same way.
- **`spec check`:** the new test's name starts with `r2201001_` and its file is already in R2201001's `proven_in`. The R-ids in the comments (R77, R179, R2201001) all exist; I ran `spec check` with this code and it passed.
- **Shipping by accident:** never run `patches ship` in your own worktree. It deletes the pending fragment and writes `crates/cards/patches/` and `crates/server/.env.example`.

**Open questions.** None for a person. Decisions made here:
- **Fix the test, not the engine.** Rejected: holding a fused namer's named cards in the engine, which goes against R2201001's exception and R77.
- **Also make `named_by_a_card_in_play` see fused cards.** It has the same bare-id flaw: a fused Crawler whose Death adds Toxopid would fail this test on some later history. Rejected: leaving it for the next stuck promotion.
- **No new ruling.** R77 and R2201001 already decide this.
- **Rejected: listing the fused id in `NAMES_A_HELD_CARD`.** Its `t-<n>` count differs from game to game.
````
